dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible structures include a large, central tripartite ring complex with high-intensity white perimeters and dark interiors. Two smaller, discrete elliptical rings are located dorsally, showing a sharp transition from the dark background to a bright perimeter. A ventral 'C' shaped structure exhibits a high-contrast boundary with a sharp gradient from the dark body to the bright markings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of high-intensity pixels are concentrated in the anterior neck region and the ventral-midsection. These clusters appear as dense, asymmetrical groups of bright pixels lacking internal gradients, contrasted against the lower-intensity background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the two discrete dorsal rings and the central multi-lobed complex form a scalene triangle. Connecting these to the ventral 'C' structure's centroid defines a wide-angled quadrilateral across the lateral field.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique tripartite ring formation in the mid-lateral region, where three distinct high-intensity loops converge to form a complex clover-like geometry.
